scenario.body: You need a maintenance proposal for Fjordview Hotel. Instead of starting from scratch, you pick the "Service Proposal" template. The AI pre-fills client details from CRM, recent inspection findings from your reports, and pricing from your product catalog. You edit two sentences and send.
scenario.closing: From blank page to sent proposal in under two minutes.
